name: claude-inline-images
description: Renders ![](…) images inline in the Claude Code chat panel by patching the installed anthropic.claude-code extension, and re-applies that patch whenever an update removes it. Modifies another extension's files on disk; fully reversible, and undone automatically on uninstall.

claudeInlineImages.autoPatch.description: Re-apply the inline-image patch to the installed Claude Code extension automatically at startup when it is missing. Turn this off to leave the Claude Code files untouched; the apply/remove commands still work on demand.

commands.title: Claude Inline Images: Show Patch Status
